methodology.question: Can financial tightness beyond prevailing economic activity/inflation distinguish stressful dollar strength from healthy-growth dollar strength? This adds a distinct archived macro information channel,not a prior/temperature/stock-bound rescue of the sixteenth learner.
methodology.source_defined_sign: Chicago Fed Letter386 explains positive ANFCI as financial conditions tighter than typically suggested by economic activity and inflation. Zero is source-defined,not fitted to portfolio returns. The2017 estimation/macro-adjustment changes are acknowledged;actual own-vintage values are retained,not retrospectively rebuilt using the new method. Exact historical method-switch timing is not authenticated.
methodology.donor: Read the complete frozen fifteenth desired matrix,not its generator. Its BIL0 or49%encodes the original published-dollar63-session guard. Preserve its stock/gold relative split,half-SOXX/equal-four-style stock composition andallprice/option information.
methodology.rule: At every original month end,first require the current ANFCI own-vintage reading to be finite and at most14calendar days old. Retain the donor half-risk allocation only when the original dollar guard is active AND fresh ANFCI is strictly positive. Otherwise restore its non-BIL weights proportionally to98%and set BILzero. A donor already at98%non-BIL is unchanged. Equality atzero does not confirm stress. This can increase risk and worsen drawdown.
methodology.missingness: Stale actual snapshots never enter the numeric rule,even when the dollar condition is false. Leave the entire candidate target row undefined,record source/date/age/reason,and issue no new request while keeping actual holdings andcash. Existing pending fills are not canceled. Every formal return,fee and mark-to-market session remains. The known2022-12-30abstention is a consequence of this generic age rule,not a calendar exception. Unknown hashes,missing query rows,malformed data or budget errors stop rather than default.
